newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India GDRs climb on steady volumes.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India GDRs climb on steady volumes.

text.p: Indian global depository receipts (GDRs) posted steady gains on good volumes on Thursday, traders said.
They said gains in Bombay had supported the market, which was attracting buyers despite concern that an impending issue by VSNL could dampen demand in the market.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index rose 1.17 percent to 3,732.05.
Bajaj, Hindalco and SBI attracted good volumes, traders said, Bajaj adding $1.31 to $31.00/$32.00.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index added 0.62 percent by the close to 74.32, while the premium rose to 17.05 percent from 16.89 percent.
In other Asian markets, the Capel Taiwan GDR Index added 0.77 point to 118.91. The discount to the local market was 0.63 percent.
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended 1.31 points lower at 55.69, while the premium fell to 34.20 from 39.20 percent.
